description: Declarative Hermes cron schedule. Replaces NovelKit's legacy scheduler + React UI (Resolved Decision #2). Each job names a registered novelkit_* tool the Orchestrator delegates to on its trigger. No imperative scheduler code ships with NovelKit; Hermes cron owns execution.

jobs.name: style_audit
jobs.description: Style Coherence Audit every 10 chapters vs the baseline chapters, to catch model/prose drift (Requirements 6.5, 11.4).

jobs.name: rolling_seed
jobs.description: Rolling-window auto-seed of the next chapter batch after a successful sync (size=5, min_remaining=3) (Requirement 10.3).

jobs.name: arc_boundary_maintenance
jobs.description: Compass mode: after a successful sync, check arc/volume boundary and surface the next expansion/summary to schedule (Req 1, 2, 3).

jobs.name: creative_health_diag
jobs.description: Creative-health diagnostics every 20 chapters (foreshadow/compass/summary/character drift) — report-only (Req 10).
